## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the rectangular playingcards pack, put it in the medium basket with smooth texture, move the medium basket with smooth texture.

Task description: Put the rectangular playing-card box on the right side of the table into the smooth orange medium basket in the center, then lift and move the basket containing it.

Success criteria: The card box remains inside the basket, near and touching its body, and no longer touches the table. Both basket and card box are clearly higher than their initial positions, with the opening upward and no excessive tilt. Merely sliding the basket along the table is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- When grasping the card box, close across its short dimension onto the middle of both long sides, opening slightly wider than the box. Before closing, confirm the pads surround the sides without resting on the table, avoiding pressing the top and causing sliding or an empty grasp.
- Insert the card box through an unobstructed basket-opening area beside the handle, leaving rim clearance for corners and fingers. Release after interior support is obtained to reduce rim collisions or falling out.
- When grasping the basket, consider gripping its thin rim wall with one finger inside and one outside. Choose a relatively straight section away from handle joints whose inside is not blocked by the card box. Fully seat the pads against the wall and match the opening to local thickness to reduce slipping and squeezing the card box.
- When lifting the basket, keep its opening upward and accelerate/decelerate smoothly. Leave clearance from the handle and bottles behind it so the card box does not slip out or the basket hit nearby objects.
